title: Binary Log Loss
signature: def log_loss(y_true: np.ndarray, p: np.ndarray, eps: float = 1e-15) -> float
hints: Each sample contributes -(y log p + (1 - y) log(1 - p)).
A probability of exactly 0 or 1 makes log blow up to -inf. Clip p into [eps, 1 - eps] first.
Return the mean over samples, not the sum.
